findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "imergea_get_advisory_booking_link" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Return the localized, preselected secure human-handoff URL for a PAID valuation review, buyer/investor longlist, teaser and Information Memorandum, or full deal…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: imergea_list_advisory_services, imergea_get_advisory_booking_link · Private data: imergea_business_valuation, imergea_get_advisory_booking_link, imergea_refer_deal · Public sink: imergea_get_advisory_booking_link, imergea_partner_application.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: imergea_list_advisory_services, imergea_get_advisory_booking_link · Private data: imergea_business_valuation, imergea_get_advisory_booking_link, imergea_refer_deal · Public sink: imergea_get_advisory_booking_link, imergea_partner_application

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
